description.value: Homeland Cafe & Bar sits on Marine Drive in White Rock, a popular waterfront cycling corridor, and blends South Asian and Western cuisine — from VADA PAV and paneer bhurji paratha to Cajun chicken sandwiches and ceremonial-grade matcha drinks. The cafe operates with a full bar and outdoor seating, making it a potential stop for cyclists riding the White Rock promenade route. The menu spans breakfast, brunch, and evening service with a notable range of plant-based and vegetarian options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website successfully fetched and confirms the address (15065 Marine Dr, White Rock, BC V4B 1C5) and provides a phone number absent from OSM. The menu shows clear vegan options (VEGAN CLUB SANDWICH, VADA PAV) and South Asian vegetarian dishes, and an ORDER link indicates takeout availability. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; the About page retains default WordPress placeholder text, suggesting an incomplete website setup.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Homeland Café Restaurant Bar' but the website consistently uses 'Homeland Cafe & Bar'.
The About page contains verbatim default WordPress placeholder text ('This is an example of a page...'), indicating the website is not fully built out and may not be a reliable information source.
Phone number (604) 712-5334 is sourced from the website only — OSM has no phone entry to cross-check against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operating cafe on the White Rock Marine Drive cycling route with outdoor seating and strong vegan/vegetarian menu, but bike parking (a required criterion) is entirely unconfirmed. On-site verification of bike facilities is needed before a confident include decision.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes explicitly vegan items (VEGAN CLUB SANDWICH with plant-based mayo, VADA PAV) and vegetarian South Asian dishes (aanda/paneer bhurji paratha, SPINACH MUSHROOM OMELETTE). No GF mention found
